answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 683 Country: BB Title: Is milad-un-nabi allowed to be celebrated on 12th rabi-ul-awal? Question: Is milad-un-nabi allowed to be celebrated on 12th rabi-ul-awal? Answer ID: 683 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 604/J) It was never celebrated in Sahaba period; therefore it is an innovation (Bidat). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
